p: seed royal: Meaning, all the posterity of Jehoshaphat, to whom the kingdom belonged: thus God used the cruelty of this woman to destroy the family of Ahab.
took Joash the son of Ahaziah: The Lord promised to maintain the family of David, and not to quench the light of it, therefore he moved the heart of Jehosheba to preserve him.
the bedchamber from Athaliah: Where the priests slept.
Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers: The chief priest, Jehosheba's husband.
you that enter in on the: Of the Levites, who had charge of the keeping of the temple, and kept watch by course.
even be keepers of the watch: That no one should come on them, while they were crowning the king.
Sur: Called the east gate of the temple, 2Ch 23:5.
go forth on the sabbath: Whose charge is ended.
priest give king David's spears and: That is, Jehoiada.
the king's son: That is, Joash, who had been kept secret six years.
the testimony: Meaning, the law of God, which is his chief charge, and by which only his throne is established.
pillar: Where the king's place was in the temple.
followeth her kill with the sword: To take her part.
covenant between the LORD and the: That both the king and the people should maintain the true worship of God and destroy all idolatry.
king also and the people: That he should govern and they obey in the fear of God.
altars: Even in the place where he had blasphemed God, and thought to have been helped by his idol, there God poured his vengeance on him.
priest appointed officers over the house: That is, Jehoiada.
and they slew Athaliah with the: Who by his cruelty and persecution had troubled the whole land.
